_comment: Copia este fichero a ~/.alfabeta/config.json y rellénalo. Nunca lo subas al repo.

storage._comment: mirrors: folders in the other accounts' Drives, mounted by Google Drive for desktop, brought up to date one-way from base_dir (the master) after every sync; [] for none.

calendar._comment: shared_with: accounts the one calendar is shared with, each with "see all event details"; [] for none.

notebook._comment: share_with: accounts invited as viewers to every topic notebook; [] for none.
